title: The 3 Money Hacks Millionaires Use Every Day

scenes.text: What 3 habits let the ultra‑rich grow wealth while you sleep?
Pay yourself first – automatically move 10% of every paycheck into a high‑yield savings or investment account.
scenes.label: PAY YOURSELF FIRST
scenes.query: automatic paycheck savings 10% high yield account

scenes.text: Use the Rule of 72 – at a 9% annual return your money doubles roughly every 8 years, so let compounding work.
scenes.label: RULE OF 72

scenes.text: Avoid lifestyle inflation – keep expenses flat even when income rises, funnel extra cash into investments.
scenes.label: NO LIFESTYLE INFLATION
scenes.query2: keeping expenses flat while earning more
